content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bathinda Vacancy 2026 - Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 77 posts are on offer: 17 Professor, 5 Additional Professor, 23 Associate Professor, and 32 Assistant Professor, spread across various clinical and para-clinical departments. Department-wise category breakdowns are given below. If a suitable candidate is not found for an Additional Professor post, that post may be filled by a lower cadre (Associate Professor or Assistant Professor) in the same category and discipline. Candidates eligible for the lower cadre may also apply where a higher-cadre post is advertised, in which case selection would be for a tenure of 5–7 years. The same downgrade provision applies here: if a suitable candidate is not found for an Associate Professor post, it may be filled by an Assistant Professor of the same category and discipline, and candidates eligible only for Assistant Professor may also apply, with selection for a 5–7 year tenure. Note: the source notification's serial numbers for Assistant Professor posts run 1–19 then jump to 21 (no serial 20 appears); this listing follows the notification's own sequence. All vacancies are provisional and subject to variation as per Government of India rules, at the discretion of the Executive Director, AIIMS, Bathinda.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bathinda Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received within the prescribed date/time, with the requisite fee, are scrutinized by the Institute's scrutiny committee. Only eligible candidates are called for a personal interview before the Standing Selection Committee of the Institute. If the number of applicants is large, the selection committee may devise shortlisting criteria, which may include a written examination. Interview date, time, and shortlisting information will be published only on the AIIMS Bathinda website, and interview letters will be sent by email only. The interview will be held at AIIMS Bathinda only; online interviews (e.g., via Skype/Viber) are not permitted, and no TA/DA is paid for attending. Selected candidates must be declared medically fit by the competent authority; appointment is subject to a review/probation period of two years.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Bathinda Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by AIIMS, Bathinda, under Notification No. AIIMS/BTI/RC/Faculty/2026/2373 dated 31 July 2026, to fill 77 Group-A faculty posts - Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor - across various departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Bathinda Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 77 vacancies in total: 17 Professor, 5 Additional Professor, 23 Associate Professor, and 32 Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bathinda Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mandatory Google Form must be submitted by 21 August 2026, 5:00 PM IST. The hard-copy application must separately reach the Recruitment Cell by 28 August 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for AIIMS Bathinda Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 2,360 for General/OBC/EWS candidates, Rs. 1,180 for SC/ST candidates, and Nil for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities - payable online only via SBI Collect.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Bathinda Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 58 years for Professor/Additional Professor, and 50 years for Associate Professor/Assistant Professor, as on the closing date (21 August 2026), with category-wise age relaxation as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for AIIMS Bathinda Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must complete two steps: submit the mandatory online Google Form, and separately send a printed hard-copy application with self-attested documents and the fee transaction receipt by Registered/Speed Post to the Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Bathinda. See the "How to Apply" section above for full details.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for AIIMS Bathinda Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisted/eligible candidates are called for a personal interview before the Standing Selection Committee at AIIMS Bathinda. If applicant numbers are large, additional shortlisting criteria, including a written examination, may be used.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for AIIMS Bathinda faculty posts?
faq.answer: Professor: Level-14-A (Rs. 1,68,900–2,20,400); Additional Professor: Level-13-A2+ (Rs. 1,48,200–2,11,400); Associate Professor: Level-13-A1+ (Rs. 1,38,300–2,09,200); Assistant Professor: Level-12 (Rs. 1,01,500–1,67,400) - all under 7th CPC, plus usual allowances including NPA where applicable.
